answer: Require every agent to lock 400 POA for 90 days before earning, with 100% slashed on a proven duplicate. The bond sits on a ledger that moves like a glacier, slow, visible, impossible to rewrite. Each identity also carries a lantern record: funding source, grading history, attestations, all public. When a tide of new identities arrives sharing one funder, the tally freezes every identity from that funder after the third match and forfeits each bond. One thousand fakes cost 400,000 POA plus 90 days of lockup each, no bulk discount, because every fake needs its own bond and funding trail.
